name: Proposal
description: A named-customer proposal deck that reads as a page: deep forest ink on paper off-white, an acid-lime primary and warm peach accents, DM Sans set large, and a fixed thumbnail rail that makes every later beat one click away.
whenToUse: Pick for a document addressed to ONE named audience and argued from top to bottom: a client or partner proposal, a programme or benefit pitch, an account plan, a board or steering-group brief, a working-session leave-behind. The chain is a complete narrative — a dark image-led opening, a persistent section rail outside the story flow, a three-pillar argument, an editorial image collage carrying principles as social proof, a dark step-by-step rollout with a sticky image, a high-contrast ask, and a compact sign-off. Human photography rather than product screenshots; practical and collective in voice. Prefer Pitch Deck instead when the piece is a full-viewport slide-per-idea keynote, and SaaS Landing when the goal is self-serve conversion rather than a meeting.
